name: mr-screen
why: The eight questions the inclusion screen was written for, and the three it may not damage. All eleven are enumeration-shaped by the product's own classifyQuestionShape, so under an operands control they still read enumerated's bytes and the comparison is one variable. The eight are wrong by exactly -1 on 41222844945; the three are wrong by exactly +1.

reads.decisive: one side at or below one correct read, the other at or above three, out of four repetitions
reads.mixed: anything else, counted and printed but not attributed, because a 2-of-4 split is what the measured 4.8% per-read flip rate produces on its own
